implemented_requirements.requirement: Track items, numeric variables, and flags for the player
implemented_requirements.evidence: Both gamestate.py and main.py define a GameState class with methods add_item, remove_item, has_item, adjust_var, get_var, set_flag, and has_flag.
The STORY variable is defined as a placeholder "{ ... }" with no actual narrative content.
The get_available_choices function is declared but its body is replaced by an ellipsis, so no branching logic is implemented.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player decisions influence subsequent story events
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code applies effects of choices to the GameState; apply_effects is a stub.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Store branches in a structured way
implemented_requirements.evidence: STORY is a placeholder dictionary; no structured branch data is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Use conditional checks to shape the storyline
implemented_requirements.evidence: evaluate_condition is declared but contains only an ellipsis; no conditional logic is implemented.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Interactive loop to present text and accept player input
implemented_requirements.evidence: main() is defined but its body is omitted (ellipsis), and prompt_choice is also a stub.

critical_issues: Core functions (evaluate_condition, apply_effects, get_available_choices, prompt_choice, main) contain only ellipsis placeholders and are non‑functional.
The STORY data structure is empty, providing no narrative or branching information.
Duplicate GameState definitions cause confusion and potential runtime errors.
No code exists to render narrative text, display choices, or update the game state based on player input.
judge.summary: The repository includes a partially implemented GameState class, but all essential storytelling components are stubbed out. Narrative data, branching logic, condition evaluation, effect application, and the main game loop are missing. Consequently, the project does not meet the benchmark requirements and is unlikely to run as an interactive storytelling game.
